vectors.scenario: three distinct source captures plus v6/v7/v9/v10 component inputs produce deterministic immutable pack
component digest is changed after pack creation
evidence-chain link or entry hash is changed
source evidence hash/generation/time differs from v7/v9 raw inputs
one source class missing, duplicated, or evidence hash reused
component or pack claims effects, finality, execution authority or non-zero live value
one underlying v6/v7/v9/v10 component fails independent verification
caller presents VERIFIED_IMMUTABLE_EVIDENCE_PACK to Trust Gateway candidate execute admission

required_invariants: source captures are registry, custody and representation exactly once each
component digests are computed from canonical JSON
evidence chain is hash-linked in deterministic order
source captures bind to both legal reconciliation records and temporal coherence observations
all underlying v6/v7/v9/v10 verification must pass
credentials or private signing material are forbidden from pack components
verified evidence pack does not grant execution or promotion authority
live value remains disabled and max live value remains 0
non_claims: real production registry/custodian endpoints have been exercised
evidence pack establishes legal or settlement finality
